subject: Request: penetration test report access & NDA redlines
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@orchidhealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: secops@orchidhealth.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request for penetration test report and exec summary for SOC 2 audit

Hi Jonas,

We're supporting an upcoming SOC 2 audit and our security team has asked for Redwood's most recent penetration test report and the executive summary. Can you confirm whether you can share the full report (redacted as needed) and an unredacted exec summary? Our security reviewers (cc'd) prefer to see the full findings before we complete our vendor assessment.

A few details they asked to confirm up front:
- Is the report covered by an NDA?
- Do you allow sharing with a third-party auditor and our procurement/legal team?
- Do you provide a remediation tracker that maps findings to fixes and timelines?

If there's a preferred process (secure viewer only, watermarking, NDA), please let us know.

Thanks — happy to schedule a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Elena Morales
Director, Vendor Risk
Orchid Health

[Attachment: SOC2-request-form.pdf (stub)]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request for penetration test report and exec summary for SOC 2 audit

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and context. We're glad to support Orchid's audit. Quick answers up front: yes, the penetration test report is confidential and we share it under a mutual NDA; we can also provide a redacted executive summary for general distribution.

Options we typically offer:
1) Executive summary (redacted) as a PDF that you can circulate.
2) Full technical report delivered via our secure viewer (read-only link, watermarking, 30-day access) to named recipients only.
3) Remediation tracker CSV mapping each finding to owner/status/date.

I'll loop in our legal/business ops to propose an NDA and a secured delivery plan. For the viewer option we'll need a list of named recipients (full name + corporate email). If you prefer us to send the file instead of a viewer, we can, but we prefer the viewer for forensic reports.

Attaching a provisional mutual NDA with a couple of common redlines we accept. Please mark up with your legal team and return.

Attachments: Mutual-NDA-redline-REDWOOD_vORCHID.docx (stub)

Next steps: if you can confirm named viewers and whether you need the remediation tracker, we'll prepare the exec summary and set up the secure link.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

From: Mark Liu <mark.liu@orchidhealth.com>

Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request for penetration test report and exec summary for SOC 2 audit

Jonas — thanks for the quick reply. A few clarifications from our security team:
- They need access to the full findings (not just exec summary) to validate scope and criticality.
- The remediation tracker is required. We will not externally publish the report.
- We prefer a time-limited secure viewer with watermarking, but only if the viewer preserves original finding text (no additional redaction beyond vendor-sensitive customer data).

I've attached a short doc listing our standard requirements. Also: our legal team will likely propose two redlines to the NDA (1) limit use to internal reviewers and auditors, and (2) require reasonable redaction carveouts for PII related to our customers.

Appreciate the help — if we can get the secure viewer + remediation tracker that should be sufficient.

-Mark

[Attachment: Orchid-Sec-Reqs.docx (stub)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Mark Liu <mark.liu@orchidhealth.com>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Request for penetration test report and exec summary for SOC 2 audit — NDA redlines and delivery proposal

Hi Mark / Elena — I'm Kimberly from Redwood Legal. Thanks for sharing Orchid's requirements and the NDA redlines. We are comfortable with most of what you've proposed but need to agree a few practical controls given the sensitivity of raw testing artefacts. Proposed approach: 

1) Mutual NDA: we'll accept (1) limit of use to internal reviewers and auditors, and (2) carveouts for customer PII. We will not agree to unlimited retention — our standard is 3 years for sensitive reports unless otherwise negotiated.

2) Secure delivery: we prefer to provide the full report via our secure viewer (https://files.redwood.ai/secureview/abc123). Benefits: read-only, watermarking (recipient name + timestamp), access logs (IP + download attempts), and we can revoke access immediately. We will provision 30 days by default, extendable on request.

3) Redaction policy: Redwood will remove any customer-identifying data and infrastructure hostnames that are not necessary to validate findings. We will not redact technical details of vulnerabilities that are critical to assessment. We'll provide an executive summary PDF (redacted) that is safe for broader circulation.

4) Remediation tracker: we will provide a CSV mapping severity, finding id, remediation owner, status, and targeted completion date; we can update this tracker weekly during remediation.

Attachments: please find attached a redlined Mutual-NDA we propose (Mutual-NDA-redline-REDWOOD_vORCHID.docx). If Orchid legal returns a marked-up version, please highlight any terms you feel are non-negotiable.

If the above sounds acceptable, we will: (a) finalize NDA, (b) prepare the exec summary PDF and remediation tracker stub, and (c) provision the secure viewer link to named recipients.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@orchidhealth.com>

Kimberly — thanks for the thoughtful proposal. The secure viewer + watermarking + 30-day access meets most of our requirements. A couple of asks before we finalize: 
- Can Redwood provide an audit log export (CSV) showing viewer accesses (timestamp, recipient, IP) for our auditors?
- Would Redwood consider a 60-day access period for the primary reviewer (if requested)?

We'll review the NDA redline and get back with any specific edits. Once NDA is in place, please provision the viewer for:
- Elena Morales <elena.morales@orchidhealth.com>
- Mark Liu <mark.liu@orchidhealth.com>
- Priya Singh <priya.singh@orchidhealth.com> (Orchid external auditor)

If you can also provide the redacted exec summary and a remediation tracker CSV in parallel, that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Elena
